mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pi_info ( ID, professional, pi_photo_path, senior_title_certificate_path, senior_title_appointment_path, signed_resume_path, qualification_certificate_path, practice_certificate_path, gcp_certificate_path, shanchang, clinical_participation, clinical_reason, clinical_root_path ) VALUES ( #{Id}, #{professional}, #{piPhotoPath}, #{seniorTitleCertificatePath}, #{seniorTitleAppointmentPath}, #{signedResumePath}, #{qualificationCertificatePath}, #{practiceCertificatePath}, #{gcpCertificatePath}, #{shanchang}, #{clinicalParticipation}, #{clinicalReason}, #{clinicalRootPath} )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, professional, pi_photo_path, senior_title_certificate_path, senior_title_appointment_path, signed_resume_path, qualification_certificate_path, practice_certificate_path, gcp_certificate_path, shanchang, clinical_participation, clinical_reason, apply_status, current_step, submit_time, pi_info_id FROM pi_info WHERE pi_info_id = #{piInfoId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pi_approval_log ( pi_info_id, pi_id, approver_id, role, current_step, apply_status, comment, approve_time ) VALUES ( #{piInfoId}, #{piId}, #{approverId}, #{role}, #{currentStep}, #{applyStatus}, #{comment}, #{approveTime} )
INSERT INTO pi_info (id, professional,apply_type,current_step, apply_status) VALUES (#{id}, #{professional}, #{applyType}, 1,'PENDING_APPROVAL')
mapper.select: SELECT pi_info_id FROM pi_info WHERE id = #{id} ORDER BY pi_info_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pi_info SET pi_photo_path = #{piPhotoPath}, senior_title_certificate_path = #{seniorTitleCertificatePath}, senior_title_appointment_path = #{seniorTitleAppointmentPath}, signed_resume_path = #{signedResumePath}, qualification_certificate_path = #{qualificationCertificatePath}, practice_certificate_path = #{practiceCertificatePath}, gcp_certificate_path = #{gcpCertificatePath}, clinical_participation = #{clinicalParticipation}, clinical_reason = #{clinicalReason}, clinical_root_path = #{clinicalRootPath}, report_file_path = #{selfAssessmentReportPath}, record_types = #{recordTypes}, hospital_areas = #{hospitalAreas} WHERE pi_info_id = #{piInfoId}
mapper.select: SELECT pi_info_id, id, professional, pi_photo_path, senior_title_certificate_path, senior_title_appointment_path, signed_resume_path, qualification_certificate_path, practice_certificate_path, gcp_certificate_path, shanchang, clinical_participation, clinical_reason, clinical_root_path, record_types, hospital_areas, report_file_path, current_step, apply_status, submit_time FROM pi_info WHERE id = #{id} AND professional = #{professional} ORDER BY pi_info_id ASC

SELECT pi.ID, pi.professional, pi.apply_type AS applyType, pi.current_step AS currentStep,
-- 文件路径 pi.pi_photo_path AS piPhotoPath, pi.senior_title_certificate_path AS seniorTitleCertificatePath, pi.senior_title_appointment_path AS seniorTitleAppointmentPath, pi.signed_resume_path AS signedResumePath, pi.qualification_certificate_path AS qualificationCertificatePath, pi.practice_certificate_path AS practiceCertificatePath, pi.gcp_certificate_path AS gcpCertificatePath, pi.report_file_path AS reportFilePath,
-- 业务字段 pi.shanchang, pi.clinical_participation AS clinicalParticipation, pi.clinical_reason AS clinicalReason,
-- 专业组 pi.record_types AS recordTypes, pi.hospital_areas AS hospitalAreas,
pi.pi_info_id AS piInfoId
FROM pi_info pi WHERE pi.pi_info_id = #{piInfoId}
